resources.string: Monitors physical Volume Up and Down keys to enforce media volume 0 protection and allow emergency Volume Up override.
Physical Volume Up and Down key interception requires Volume Guard\'s Accessibility Service. Android requires you to enable this service in system settings.
Protected media volume is strictly locked to 0.
Pressing physical Volume Up disables the guard immediately and allows volume to increase normally.
Pressing physical Volume Down keeps the guard active and forces volume to 0.
